refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the piecewise cubic Hermite interpolating polynomial.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: v = pchip(x, y) v = pchip(x, y, xx)

listitem.para: A vector of input data points.
A vector or matrix of function values at the points in `x`. If `y` is a vector, it must have the same length as `x`. If `y` is a matrix, the last dimension of `y` must equal the length of `x`.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `pchip` function computes the piecewise cubic Hermite interpolating polynomial for the given data points `x` and `y`. If the optional parameter `xx` is provided, the function evaluates the interpolating polynomial at the points in `xx`.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: x = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] y = [1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0] xx = linspace(0, 5, 800) v1 = pchip(x, y) v2 = pchip(x, y, xx) plot(x, y, 'o', xx, v2)
